gloss: imperial family; member of the imperial family

definitions.gloss: imperial family; member of the imperial family
definitions.explanation: A member of the Japanese Imperial Family, or the imperial family as a collective body. Legally defined under the Imperial House Law.

examples.japanese: {皇族|こうぞく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方々|かたがた}→方々：02778_katagata⟧。
{皇族|こうぞく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{被災地|ひさいち}→被災地：27434_hisaichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪問|ほうもん}→訪問：03622_houmon⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A member of the imperial family visited the disaster-stricken area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧{皇族|こうぞく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{皇籍|こうせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}れる→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧ことになっている。
examples.english: When a female member of the imperial family marries, she leaves the imperial register.

notes:
A compound of {皇|こう} (emperor/imperial) and {族|ぞく} (clan/family). Refers specifically to the Japanese Imperial Family as defined by the {皇室典範|こうしつてんぱん} (Imperial House Law).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {皇族|こうぞく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧: a member of the imperial family (respectful)
- ⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧{皇族|こうぞく}: female imperial family member
- {皇族|こうぞく}{費|ひ}: imperial family allowance

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{皇室|こうしつ}→皇室：11339_koushitsu⟧: Imperial House — refers to the institution rather than individual members
- ⟦{天皇|てんのう}→天皇：04546_tennou⟧: Emperor — the head of the imperial family specifically
- ⟦{王族|おうぞく}→王族：13587_ouzoku⟧: royalty — used for royal families of other countries
